evidence.limits: No whisper.srt when coded: words come from burned-in captions (hook 0-5 s complete at 4 fps, later sampled once a second, so some words are missed). Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Reason number 1 you will not want to start a business: you will have to work more time (about 10 hours a day, 300 hours a month, against 180 hours as an employee), giving up evenings, friends, couples and family events, 'in the beginning of the way'.
audience: aspiring business owners and employees thinking of starting a business
caption_vs_video_note: Caption is a lead-capture offer: comment 'אני' to get a special video on why you must not start a business ('כן כן שמעתם נכון'). The video itself is that kind of teaser: it gives reason #1 and ends by repeating the first line, so it is itself the 'why not start a business' content, framed as a contrarian warning.

story.setup: 'Reason #1 you do not want to start a business.'
story.stakes: Working more hours and losing a social life.
story.progression: More time: you work more than when you were an employee; a full-time job is about 180 hours a month and most people in their 20s work nearer 120; at the start of a business 10 hours a day times 30 days is 300 hours, about twice an employee's; you will give up evenings, friends, couples, family and social events.
story.payoff: You will give up a lot at the beginning of the road, so it takes more time.
story.resolution: The opening line is repeated at the end.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: only reason #1 is given; the other reasons are promised through the caption's DM video
